svg.title: LANL cyber1 - distribution across the five files
svg.desc: How the 1,648,275,307 events are spread across auth, proc, flows, dns and redteam, with each file's record layout and shared identifiers.
svg.text: redteam.txt: 749 of these auth events (0.00007 % of auth)
Windows authentication events – desktops, servers, AD domain controllers
process start / stop events – Windows desktops and servers
network flow events – central routers (duration in seconds)
DNS lookup events – central DNS servers
red team compromise events – every line is also an event in auth.txt
